title: Concept drift detection in image data stream: a survey on current literature, limitations and future directions
core_idea: Provide the first comprehensive survey of concept drift detection methods tailored for image data streams, proposing a novel taxonomy that categorizes approaches by image feature handling, detection strategy, detection level, concept drift cause, and evaluation considerations, and analyzing representative methods to identify current approaches and limitations.
tldr: A survey that organizes and reviews concept drift detection methods for image data streams via a new taxonomy, analyzes 14 representative methods, and outlines directions for future research.
